title: Panel-level and glass-core advanced packaging: CoPoS, FOPLP, 310/515/600 mm panels, glass interposers/cores, players and timelines
why_it_matters: Every major provider (TSMC CoPoS, ASE 310 mm line from Q1 2027, Rapidus 600 mm RDL panel, Samsung I-CubeE on FO-PLP) is moving very large AI packages from 300 mm wafers to panels, with volume around 2028-29; this changes equipment, substrate and capacity maths.
questions: Which panel sizes and formats does each provider use, and when does each reach volume?
What yield/warpage problems remain and which tools (litho, plating, bonders) are panel-capable?
Who supplies glass cores/interposers and at what readiness?
primary_sources: TSMC, ASE and Rapidus earnings calls and releases

title: Intel Foundry advanced packaging as a merchant business: EMIB-T/Foveros customers, capacity (New Mexico, Malaysia, Arizona), Amkor partnership and substrate prepayments
why_it_matters: Intel is the main non-TSMC 2.5D alternative (EMIB-T scaling from 2026, analyst capacity of 15-20k CoWoS-equivalent wafers/month in 2027), but its customers, sites and economics are barely documented.
questions: Which external customers have committed to EMIB-T/Foveros packaging?
What capacity does Intel have in New Mexico and Malaysia, and what role does Amkor play?
